Name: Tool Hotkeys
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef]Register hotkeys for the tools you use most often.
This is especially useful for controller players.
Even if you use an auto-swap tool mod, Tool Hotkeys can take priority when you need it to.
When you press a tool hotkey, that tool will stay equipped until you press the unlock key. Once unlocked, your auto-swap tool mod can take over again.
Use both mods together and free yourself from those tiny little tool-swapping annoyances.
You can change the keys anytime with GMCM.
[/color][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#00ffff]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Unzip the downloaded file and place the mod folder in
[/size][/color]
[code]steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]

Manifest.Name: Tool Hotkeys
Manifest.Description: Press configurable hotkeys to equip tools, with optional manual lock support.
